title: Internal script error! Opcode: 0 (please report)
body:
### Tested versions

v4.7.beta3.official [860821708]

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta3 - macOS Tahoe (26.5.0) - Single-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 (Apple7) - Apple M1 (8 threads) - 8.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In my project I have a "lab" scene that I want to launch very often, so I made a small plugin to keep it handy. I changed some code that handles which scene is currently "active" and this error message appeared in the console. It says "please report", so I'm reporting it.

```
  ERROR: modules/gdscript/gdscript_vm.cpp:763 - Condition ' (ip + 7 + _pointer_size) > _code_size ' is true. Breaking..:
  ERROR: res://addons/Lab launch/Lab launch.gd:36 - Internal script error! Opcode: 0 (please report).

```

### Steps to reproduce

I don't think I can reproduce it. Anyway here is what happened… I changed some code in a plugin that I use for scene previewing. Here is the code:

```gdscript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

const SCENE_PATH := "res://game/p [ test room ].tscn" # I deleted the actual path part, everything after ":="
var button: Button

var run_button: Button
var open_button: Button

func _enter_tree():
	var base = get_editor_interface().get_base_control()

	# Run button
	run_button = Button.new()
	run_button.icon = base.get_theme_icon("Play", "EditorIcons")
	run_button.tooltip_text = "Run Lab"
	run_button.pressed.connect(_run_lab_scene)

	# Open button
	open_button = Button.new()
	open_button.icon = base.get_theme_icon("Load", "EditorIcons")
	open_button.tooltip_text = "Open Lab"
	open_button.pressed.connect(_open_scene)

	add_control_to_container(CONTAINER_TOOLBAR, run_button)
	add_control_to_container(CONTAINER_TOOLBAR, open_button)

func _exit_tree():
	remove_control_from_container(CONTAINER_TOOLBAR, run_button)
	remove_control_from_container(CONTAINER_TOOLBAR, open_button)

	run_button.queue_free()
	open_button.queue_free()

func _run_lab_scene():
	get_editor_interface().play_custom_scene(SCENE_PATH)

func _open_scene():
	get_editor_interface().open_scene_from_path(SCENE_PATH)

```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I was not able to isolate it.
